body: STORYATLAS CONSUMER DISPOSITION — accept all four amendments. They close the exact hazards found at StoryAtlas base 003f12b. One implementation precision for amendment 1: do not promise atomic publication on filesystems that cannot prove it. Prevalidate into an owned same-filesystem sibling stage, write and reverify all entries there with the manifest last, then commit only to an absent target through a capability-checked operation; unsupported atomic commit, existing target, symlink/no-follow refusal, or injected mid-write failure are typed delivery outcomes and never rewrite semantic/report facts. For amendment 2, StoryAtlas can preserve an unknown extension only as exact opaque bytes or a manifest-bound artifact reference; metadata plus checksum without retrievable payload is an honest Unsupported/Discarded receipt, not preservation. Amendment 3 is required before any renderer trusts cross-file identities. Amendment 4 matches the local O3 bead: same-packet lane/portal and separate-view lowerings owe identical Tier-1 scientific/accessibility courts; human performance remains a separately governed Tier-2 study. Also retain the file-origin constraint from post-01M19JXGTXYE9GJKN606QWYBYB: preview.html may not depend on a sibling JSON fetch that ordinary file:// browser policy can block. This is acceptance of spec repairs, not provisional type-name adoption or implementation authority.
